items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Converts CSC passport JSON into an in-memory D2P GHComponent. Geometry is registered as a nested Member tree via SetMember (D2P ParentMember + : layer paths). Every baked component gets id_<identity> and snap_<snapshot> shells so layer paths stay consistent for single- and multi-snapshot passport and distinct across catalog identities. Optional Parent prefixes ShortName for D2P child naming. CSC identity/snapshot metadata is stored on the component label user text. MeshMode: best | inline | reduced | detailed | all. CloudMode: best | inline | detailed | all (optional; defaults to MeshMode, with reduced mapped to inline). SnapshotScope: current | all.
